papers.title_en: RoboDreamer: Anticipatory Humanoid Locomotion with Predictive State-Space Models
papers.authors: Zhe Li, Yangyang Wei, Xichen Yuan, Zhenzhe Zhang, Weihao Yuan, Shanghang Zhang, Jianfei Yang
papers.evidence: 面向控制策略的教师-学生策略蒸馏
papers.tldr: 人形机器人运动需在感知不完美时保持稳定，并利用时序上下文。RoboDreamer采用两阶段教师-学生框架：教师先在干净观测上训练，学生则在近期观测被随机连续掩码下蒸馏，从历史推断缺失的当前信息。推理时复用同一掩码接口做隐式闭环动作精修，并可多步动作分块；Mamba作为时序骨干。IsaacLab、MuJoCo与Unitree G1实验显示掩码下跟踪更鲁棒，并成功真实部署。该工作为真实人形机器人提供可实时部署、抗观测掩码的预测性运动控制方案。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid locomotion requires control policies that remain stable under imperfect sensing while exploiting temporal context for consistent motion. We present RoboDreamer, a two-stage teacher--student framework that combines next-observation consistency with randomized continuous temporal masking. A teacher is first trained on clean observations, and a student is then distilled under masked recent observations, encouraging the policy to infer missing current information from history. At inference, the same masking interface is reused for implicit closed-loop action refinement and optional multi-step action chunking. Mamba is used as the temporal backbone, while matched ablations show that masking/distillation provides a substantial part of the gain and Mamba contributes additional tracking improvements with real-time latency. Experiments in IsaacLab, MuJoCo, and on a Unitree G1 demonstrate robust motion tracking under observation masking and successful real-world deployment.
